description: Writes a short note for the other sessions of this collaboration (what you did, what comes next), so they know what happened here. Works only if the user turned the journal on (setting journal); otherwise it says so. Never include secrets: everyone in the collaboration can read it.

decision.description: True when the note records a decision, so it shows in the map.

files.description: Paths of the files you touched.

text.description: One to three sentences: what you did or decided, and what comes next.

topic.description: A short label for what this is about (for example auth, billing-tests), so the map can group notes.

name: meshingly_journal
